## Plix Life- Driving high on Nutrition!

Plix, a [Marico acquired](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/marico-to-buy-d2c-brand-plix-for-rs-369-crore-as-smaller-players-fold-up-11036411.html) Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand, has carved its niche in the market by offering an array of irresistibly delicious nutrition goodies. What sets [Plix](https://www.plixlife.com/) apart is its commitment to making wellness an enjoyable lifestyle choice for everyone. The brand not only boasts a diverse range of products, including effervescent tablets, gummies, peanut butter, and capsules but also offers unique features like personalized plans for aging, weight-loss, and skin glow. Plix's loyalty programs and innovative BYOB (Build Your Own Box) option further solidify its rapport with regular and loyal customers. 

Industry: [Wellness & Fitness Services](https://www.linkedin.com/company/plixlife/)

Headquarters: Mumbai, India

Website: [Plix Life](https://www.plixlife.com/) 

Key Data Sources Configured: [AmazonSellerCentral,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/amazon-seller-central) [UniCommerce,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/unicommerce) [AmazonS3](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/amazon-s3), [Shopify,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/shopify) [GoogleDrive,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/google-drive) [ClickPost,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/clickpost) [FacebookAdsAdvanced](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/facebook-ads)

[GoogleSheets,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/google-sheets) [AmazonAds,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/amazon-ads) [GoogleAnalytics4,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/google-analytics-4) [GoogleAdsV2,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/google-ads) [REST](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/rest)

Data Warehouse: [DC Managed AWS Redshift](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/redshift)

Reporting Tool: Tableau

## Data Stack 

**Data Sources Configured:** 17

**Data Pipelines Configured:** 165+

**Rows moved in a Month:** 60 M+

## Delivering Personalization at Scale with DataChannel

With a mission to revolutionize the way people perceive nutrition, [Plix](https://www.plixlife.com/) ensures that there's never a dull moment on the [journey to a healthier lifestyle.](https://www.instagram.com/myplixlife/?hl=en) Plix was started with a vision to change the way the world consumes plant-based superfoods. In order to make nutrition less intimidating and fuel the habit of incorporating cleanliness, Plix focused on providing plant based superfoods as a part of a healthy, active lifestyle for every individual.

## Self-Serving Pipelines to gain the insights that matter

-   Integration of siloed data from multiple platforms including [Shopify,](https://www.shopify.com/in) [Unicommerce,](https://unicommerce.com/) [Flipkart,](https://www.flipkart.com/) [Nykaa,](https://www.nykaa.com/) [Amazon,](https://www.amazon.in/) and [Plix's own D2C website.](https://www.plixlife.com/)
-   Seamlessly fetching data from [Unicommerce,](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/unicommerce) a significant supply chain application, eliminating manual intervention.
-   Access to crucial order, return, and cancellation data facilitated by [DataChannel.](https://www.datachannel.co/)
-   Streamlining data acquisition at both product and marketing levels from [diverse sources,](https://www.datachannel.co/etl) aided by DataChannel's comprehensive ETL infrastructure.
-   Utilization of [transformed data](https://www.datachannel.co/blogs/what-is-data-transformation) to create custom audience segments for targeted marketing.

![The image shows all of the key data sources configured by DataChannel for Plixlife ](/images/cms/case-studies/plix_data-sources_datachannel-6209c7.webp)

## Plix’s Journey of Overcoming their Challenges 

Plix being a [D2C website](https://www.plixlife.com/blog/) relied heavily on data for their day-to-day product and marketing activities. As it also sells on other eCommerce websites, keeping up with customer preferences and other marketing trends was mission critical for Plix. However, without a robust data infrastructure that could scale effectively, Plix faced some major obstacles in their journey of offering personalizing nutrition to their customers. A few of primary the challenges that Plix faced earlier were:

-   Extracting marketing data from GA4 to discern user sources via UTM functionality.
-   Difficulty in finding pre-built integration with Unicommerce.
-   Acquiring fresh SKU-level data in Google Sheets for granular analysis and decision-making.
-   Obtaining data from [Farzicomm,](https://farziengineer.com/farzicom/) an ecommerce website critical for Plix's sales strategy.
-   Ensuring centralized data storage with error logging for efficient troubleshooting.

![The image shows the entire data stack that Plixlife leveraged while working with DataChannel including major data sources, the data warehouse (AWS Redshift) and reporting tableau.](/images/cms/case-studies/plix_data-stack_datachannel-8690bc.webp)

> *"As a Performance Marketer, having up-to-date data for effective retargeting & personalization can make or break the game. What we really loved about DataChannel is its low code approach, we were able to draw critical & time-sensitive marketing insights out of our data."*

> *~* [*Anusha Sanghvi, Performance Marketing at Plix*](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anusha-sanghvi/)

## Data-Driven Solutions Behind Plix's Success

Plix, heavily reliant on data for its day-to-day operations, found robust solutions through [DataChannel:](https://www.datachannel.co/)

-   Custom integration with [Unicommerce](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/unicommerce) facilitated seamless data retrieval, including order details and cancellations.
-   Enhanced granularity achieved with SKU-level data aggregation in AWS Redshift data warehouse.
-   Simplified dashboard creation using Tableau, powered by fresh & up-to-date data from Redshift.
-   Real-time data access enabled through automated email snapshots and cohort analysis.
-   Holistic data view achieved by integrating Farzicomm data into [Amazon S3](https://www.datachannel.co/integration/amazon-s3) and subsequently Redshift.
-   Error logging and real-time reporting features expedited issue resolution and ensured data accuracy.
-   DataChannel has also introduced [Plix](https://www.plixlife.com/page/why-plix) to a leading Consulting Partner who also helped them build really engaging & interactive dashboards.
